# Support

## Getting Help

- **Build questions?** Open a [Discussion](https://github.com/rbrents3000/junkyard-genius/discussions) on GitHub.
- **Found a bug?** File a [Bug Report](https://github.com/rbrents3000/junkyard-genius/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml).
- **Safety concern?** File a [Safety Report](https://github.com/rbrents3000/junkyard-genius/issues/new?template=safety-report.yml) — these get priority attention.
- **Rating dispute?** File a [Rating Dispute](https://github.com/rbrents3000/junkyard-genius/issues/new?template=rating-dispute.yml).
- **New build idea?** File a [New Build Idea](https://github.com/rbrents3000/junkyard-genius/issues/new?template=new-build-idea.yml).

## Resources

- [Reference Guides](../docs/reference/) — tools, chemicals, electronics, sourcing, and more
- [Safety Docs](../docs/safety/) — high voltage, fire, chemicals
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to submit a build

## Response Times

This is a community project maintained in spare time. Issues are typically reviewed within a few days. Safety reports are prioritized.
